# PixPawAI

> PixPawAI is an AI pet portrait generator. Upload a pet photo and get an artistic portrait in about 20–40 seconds. PayPal, one-time credit packs, credits never expire. 10% of profits go to animal shelters. Support: support@pixpawai.com. Output resolution: 1024px (not 4K).

## Credit packs

- Free: 1–2 watermarked portraits (1024px). No multi-image selection.
- Starter: $4.99 for 15 portraits, no watermark. One-time.
- Pro: $19.99 for 50 portraits, 3-image selection. One-time.
- Master: $39.99 for 200 portraits, 5-image selection. One-time.

Credits never expire. No subscription. PayPal checkout.

## Main pages

- [Pricing](https://pixpawai.com/en/pricing/): Free trial plus one-time credit packs; no subscription.
- [FAQ](https://pixpawai.com/en/faq/): Answers on supported pets, generation time, credits, refunds and downloads.
- [About](https://pixpawai.com/en/about/): What PixPawAI is and who builds it.
- [Pet Memorial](https://pixpawai.com/en/pet-memorial/): Memorial and rainbow-bridge portraits for pets that have passed away.
- [Generator (home)](https://pixpawai.com/en/): Upload a pet photo, pick a style and generate a portrait.
- [Pet Gifts](https://pixpawai.com/en/gift/): Instant pet-portrait gifts — generate in seconds, preview free, optionally printed on keepsakes.
- [Gallery](https://pixpawai.com/en/gallery/): Public portraits shared by other users, browsable by style.
- [Shop](https://pixpawai.com/en/shop/): Physical products printed with a generated portrait — canvas print, pillow, ceramic mug, phone case, t-shirt.
- [Blog](https://pixpawai.com/en/blog/): Guides on pet photography, gift ideas, pet loss and AI portrait styles.

## Art styles

- [Merry Christmas](https://pixpawai.com/en/styles/christmas-vibe/): Festive holiday portrait with a classic Santa hat.
- [Smart Casual](https://pixpawai.com/en/styles/smart-casual/): Sweater and newsboy cap on a warm studio background.
- [Music Lover](https://pixpawai.com/en/styles/music-lover/): Studio portrait with silver headphones on a deep blue background.
- [Retro Pop Art](https://pixpawai.com/en/styles/retro-pop-art/): Bold geometric shapes and flat colour blocks in a vintage poster style.
- [Bordeaux Muse](https://pixpawai.com/en/styles/bordeaux-muse/): Burgundy fashion-editorial portrait with beret, turtleneck and pearls.
- [Emerald Muse](https://pixpawai.com/en/styles/emerald-muse/): Sage-green editorial portrait with beret, cashmere scarf and jade necklace.
- [Magazine Chic](https://pixpawai.com/en/styles/magazine-chic/): Warm-toned fashion magazine portrait with designer accessories.
- [Wes Anderson Pop](https://pixpawai.com/en/styles/wes-anderson-pop/): Symmetrical, colour-blocked portrait in a Wes Anderson-inspired palette.
- [Birthday Celebration](https://pixpawai.com/en/styles/birthday-celebration/): Party scene with hat, bow tie, cake and balloons.
- [Rainbow Bridge](https://pixpawai.com/en/styles/rainbow-bridge/): Peaceful memorial tribute in a soft heavenly meadow.
- [Guardian Angel](https://pixpawai.com/en/styles/guardian-angel/): Angelic memorial tribute with soft wings and a gentle halo.
- [Watercolor Keepsake](https://pixpawai.com/en/styles/watercolor-keepsake/): Delicate watercolor memorial portrait, soft and painterly.
